_doc: Every number is a {token} from computed.json (see references/pipeline-contracts.md). {token|c} colours by sign. Verbatim quotes live in data.json quotes and are cited as {q.key}. Write per references/writing-standard.md: factual lead-ins, two sentences (what changed; why it matters), no monitoring clauses outside 'monitor', no inline labels, no typed figures anywhere.
the_print: EPS {eps.actual} vs {eps.consensus} consensus: {eps.surprise|c}; {eps.vs_guide|c} vs the {eps.guide_prior} guide midpoint.
Revenue {revenue.actual} vs {revenue.consensus} consensus: {revenue.surprise|c}. <Driver KPI> {kpi_1.actual} vs {kpi_1.guide_prior} guided ({kpi_1.yoy|c} Y/Y).
{period.next} EPS guided {eps.guide_new}, midpoint {guide.mid_vs_frozen|c} vs the frozen {period.next} consensus of {guide.frozen}; <full-year change>.
Post-print: {period.next} EPS consensus {fwd.eps_next_q.chg|c}, next fiscal year {fwd.eps_fy1.chg|c}.

summary.text: <What changed, with one or two tokens>. <Why it matters, in judgment verbs>.

scorecard_note: Consensus = {consensus.source} pre-print snapshot dated on or before {consensus.frozen_date} (contributors in brackets); † = two or fewer contributors, graded and flagged. Beat/(Miss) and vs Guide in % for $ lines, bps for rates; colour marks sign only.
guidance_read: The {period.next} EPS guide sits {guide.mid_vs_frozen|c} below/above the frozen consensus at the midpoint and {guide.high_vs_frozen|c} at the top of the range; <what the guide implies>. <Full-year implication>.
revisions_tail: <one closing sentence on where consensus now sits vs the guide>.
source: <Company> {period} earnings release (<date, timing>) and call transcript (<date>) via the InSync document store; prior periods from InSync actuals (fiscal basis). Consensus: one pre-print vintage, {consensus.source} snapshot dated on or before {consensus.frozen_date}. Post-print revisions ({consensus.post_date}) shown separately. Prices: InSync adjusted closes; market cap, EV and NTM multiples: InSync, {consensus.post_date}, on adjusted earnings. Guidance: InSync guidance database, each range verified against the release and both transcripts. Gaps: <list>. All arithmetic recalculated in code. Prepared <date>.
